concepts.name: 观照之门
concepts.brief: Two asymmetrical broad doorway planes with a quiet inward-path negative space; compact vertical architectural silhouette. Only 2 solid shapes.
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate ONE standalone minimalist brand symbol for 东方智慧 / EASTERN WISDOM, an Eastern wisdom learning and personal growth APP, trusted learning, meditation, bodily and emotional awareness, journaling and intelligent companionship. Core promise: know yourself, settle body and mind, grow through daily learning and practice. This must be a meaningful brand mark rooted in the stated concept, not a medical institution, fortune-telling app or generic SaaS icon. Only borrow the SIMPLICITY benchmark of a very simple 2-4-stroke logo, NEVER copy breathing-ring-and-dot designs. Style: refined mature flat solid one-color very dark jade green #284d43 on pure white background; optically balanced, generous negative space, bold uniform clean vector-like edges; max 2-3 solid shapes or 4 broad strokes, legible at 24px. Central symbol alone, occupying about 55% of a square canvas, all white margins ample. No text, letters, numbering, wordmark, border, app tile, mockup or watermark. No shading, gradient, texture, lighting, 3D, gold dots, nested rings, concentric arches, fingerprints, infinity symbols, swirls, circuit boards, detailed trees, mountains, lotus, anatomical bodies or tiny decoration. Make the concept recognizable in the construction and silhouette, not through extra ornaments. Unique concept 01: 观照之门 / 认识自己. Design brief: Two asymmetrical broad doorway planes with a quiet inward-path negative space; compact vertical architectural silhouette. Only 2 solid shapes.
